description: Alerts drop into place out of a blur on a spring while their icon pops into its tile and draws, and when dismissed they fade and fold their height away.
moves: The alert drops 12px into place out of a 6px blur, growing from 0.96 on a spring.
The icon pops into its tile, then its strokes draw themselves.
The title and description rise in after the icon, one after the other.
Dismissed, it fades, blurs and folds its height to nothing, so what sits below closes up.
keyboard: Moves focus to the dismiss button, when there is one.
Dismisses the alert from its dismiss button.
Dismisses the alert from its dismiss button.

propDocs.Alert.variant: How it reads: "default" for information, "destructive" for a problem.
propDocs.Alert.open: Whether the alert is shown. Set it to control the alert yourself.
propDocs.Alert.defaultOpen: Whether the alert starts shown, when you don't control it. Defaults to true.
propDocs.Alert.onOpenChange: Runs when the alert is dismissed, with details.reason "close-press".
propDocs.Alert.speed: How fast the alert moves: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
